integrity: Direct geometry and exact symbolic length identities supplement a full analytic orbit partition. Seeded numerical orbit tests do not constitute an exhaustive proof. No independent validation or certification is claimed.
limitations: Complete only for the right-isosceles similarity class, the three complete Euclidean supporting lines, and ties-fixed farthest orthogonal projection. Physicality is relative to Euclidean arclength, not planar Lebesgue measure. An unindexed equivalent result cannot be excluded.
title: Exact four-cycle basins and physical-measure selection for right-isosceles farthest projections
